info.name: Create a Collection

items.docs: A Collection refers to a group of related Documents. A Collection lets a user aggregate documents in one location. A user can utilize Collections to group particular sets of material (documents) to explore individually through Chats utilizing a large language model (LLM).

info.name: Import an already stored document to an existing collection.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Id of the collection to remove the document from.

params.name: document_id
params.description: Id of the document to be inserted.

params.name: copy_document
params.description: Whether to save a new copy of the document

params.name: preserve_metadata
params.description: Whether to preserve document metadata when copying documents.

params.name: gen_doc_summaries
params.description: Whether to auto-generate document summaries (uses LLM).

params.name: gen_doc_questions
params.description: Whether to auto-generate sample questions for each document (uses LLM).

params.name: ocr_model
params.description: Which method to use to extract text from images using AI-enabled optical character recognition (OCR) models. docTR is best for Latin text, PaddleOCR is best for certain non-Latin languages, Tesseract covers a wide range of languages. Mississippi works well on handwriting. - `auto` - Automatic will auto-select the best OCR model for every page. - `off` - Disable OCR for speed, but all images will then be skipped (also no image captions will be made).

params.name: tesseract_lang
params.description: Which language to use when using ocr_model="tesseract".

params.name: keep_tables_as_one_chunk
params.description: When tables are identified by the table parser the table tokens will be kept in a single chunk.

params.name: chunk_by_page
params.description: Each page will be a chunk. `keep_tables_as_one_chunk` will be ignored if this is `true`.

params.name: handwriting_check
params.description: Check pages for handwriting. Will use specialized models if handwriting is found.

params.name: ingest_mode
params.description: Ingest mode to use. - `standard` - Files will be ingested for use with RAG - `agent_only` - Bypasses standard ingestion. Files can only be used with agents.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout in seconds

info.name: Creates job to import collection to the collection.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Id of the destination collection.

params.name: migrate_scheduled_connectors
params.description:
Whether to move scheduled connectors from the source collection to the target collection
after documents are imported. The source collection will have no scheduled connectors
after this operation. Only the owner of both collections can use this flag.

params.name: copy_lifecycle_settings
params.description:
Whether to copy lifecycle settings (expiry_date, inactivity_interval, size_limit)
from the source collection to the target collection.

params.name: skip_reparse
params.description:
Whether to skip re-parsing documents and only re-embed existing chunks with the
target collection's embedding model. Much faster than full import since it skips
file fetch, PDF conversion, OCR, and chunking. Only re-embeds the text chunks.
Cannot be combined with copy_document=true.

params.name: copy_document
params.description: Whether to save a new copy of the document

params.name: preserve_document_status
params.description: Whether to preserve each document's original ingest mode (agent_only vs standard) when importing. When true, documents with agent_only status remain agent_only in the target collection. When false (default), all documents use the ingest_mode parameter uniformly.

params.name: preserve_metadata
params.description: Whether to preserve document metadata when copying documents.

params.name: gen_doc_summaries
params.description: Whether to auto-generate document summaries (uses LLM).

params.name: gen_doc_questions
params.description: Whether to auto-generate sample questions for each document (uses LLM).

params.name: ocr_model
params.description: Which method to use to extract text from images using AI-enabled optical character recognition (OCR) models. docTR is best for Latin text, PaddleOCR is best for certain non-Latin languages, Tesseract covers a wide range of languages. Mississippi works well on handwriting. - `auto` - Automatic will auto-select the best OCR model for every page. - `off` - Disable OCR for speed, but all images will then be skipped (also no image captions will be made).

params.name: tesseract_lang
params.description: Which language to use when using ocr_model="tesseract".

params.name: keep_tables_as_one_chunk
params.description: When tables are identified by the table parser the table tokens will be kept in a single chunk.

params.name: chunk_by_page
params.description: Each page will be a chunk. `keep_tables_as_one_chunk` will be ignored if this is `true`.

params.name: handwriting_check
params.description: Check pages for handwriting. Will use specialized models if handwriting is found.

params.name: ingest_mode
params.description: Ingest mode to use. - `standard` - Files will be ingested for use with RAG - `agent_only` - Bypasses standard ingestion. Files can only be used with agents.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout in seconds
